contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and FND-0087 does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 leaves M_{6,6} outside published CKgP, so residual CE geometry including ordered/unordered models remains load-bearing) and with the packet C66-GEO-Z bottleneck (model ordered distinct reduced divisors as a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open; do not call that open closed). Independent primary checks. (1) Diagram-theoretic reduction: for a morphism f:X→Y the reduced morphism is f_red:X_red→Y_red (Stacks Schemes Tag 01J3 uniqueness of reduced closed subscheme structure; Morphisms Tag 054M: X_red→X is a universal homeomorphism). Hence the canonical reduced form of the ordered-to-unordered torsor I→I^{red-supp} is precisely I_red→(I^{red-supp})_red, as stated. (2) Unilateral source reduction destroys flatness over nonreduced bases: elementary algebra Spec(k)→Spec(k[ε]/(ε²)) is not flat (Tor_1^{k[ε]/(ε²)}(k,k)≠0 via the length-1 nilpotent sequence 0→(ε)→k[ε]/(ε²)→k→0), while the identity on Spec(k[ε]/(ε²)) is flat (even étale). Thus if one reduces only the ordered configuration source while leaving a nonreduced reduced-support base, finite-étale/flatness of the S_6-torsor fails in general. (3) Even compatible reduction need not preserve flatness in all situations (Douady counterexample recorded by Elencwajg, MSE 1221839: a flat finite length-3 projection becomes non-flat after reducing the nonreduced source over an already-reduced base), so the finding’s warning is the correct operational constraint for any scheme-theoretic use of the ordered model, not an overstatement. Campaign embedding: corroborated FND-0064 supplies Conf_6(C/B^{bal})→(reduced-support open) as a finite étale S_6-torsor; FND-0075 restricts that torsor to the stack of pairwise-distinct sections versus coarse moduli; FND-0046 requires determinantal/Fitting comparison of CE failure with Abel–Jacobi incidence over arbitrary (possibly nonreduced) bases; FND-0047 warns that jumping h^0 prevents unqualified Proj(π_*L) identifications; FND-0083 separates Sym^6 nonemptiness from reduced-support nonemptiness. FND-0087 is the complementary nilpotent/nonreduced-base bookkeeping for reduction of that same ordered-to-unordered cover: any C66-GEO-Z construction that passes to reduced schemes, Artin local bases, or Fitting thickenings must reduce source and target of the torsor compatibly. Distinct from FND-0064 (existence of the torsor), FND-0075 (stack vs coarse descent), FND-0046 (Fitting equality over bases), FND-0047 (cohomology-and-base-change for relative linear systems), and FND-0083 (RR nonemptiness vs reduced-support open): do not merge. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source. Merge target: none.
